evidence: Substantively defines new chain parameters and verification rules in src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp, src/validation.cpp, and chainparams.
rationale: Implements BIP 95 to establish Testnet 5, fixing difficulty manipulation vulnerabilities and activating BIP 54 consensus cleanup from genesis. According to the description, previous testnets 'suffer from difficulty manipulation caused by the 20-minute minimum-difficulty rule, and lack a live test network running the proposed BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules from genesis.' A durable and usable public test network provides substantial strategic value for testing consensus changes and ecosystem integration.
